business_summary: Prebiotic soda brand offering a low-sugar, high-fiber alternative to traditional sodas, targeting health-conscious younger adults and parents.

relevant_tags.why: Directly marketed as a swap for regular soda.
Prebiotic sodas specifically target digestive/gut health.
Sold as a packaged food/beverage item.
Shelf-stable beverage suitable for kitchen pantries.

persona_conflicts.conflict: disinterested_in luxury-only messaging, vague premium positioning; high price sensitivity
persona_conflicts.evidence: $36 for a 12-pack of soda ($3/can) is a premium price point that will conflict with value-conscious consumers looking for cheap regular soda swaps.

note_signals.why: High-frequency, impulse-friendly convenience purchases align perfectly with single-serve canned beverages.
Audience responds strongly to wellness and clean-ingredient claims, matching a prebiotic low-sugar soda.
Family-oriented households looking for convenient food options align with parents looking to swap out regular soda.
Direct competitor in functional beverages, soda alternatives, and gut health; publisher will likely block.

gate_reason: The product category, pricing, and target audience are clearly defined and ready for mapping.
missing_info: Shipping rates or free shipping thresholds
clarifying_questions: Do you offer a subscription model with a discount, or is it strictly one-time purchases?
What is your threshold for free shipping on a $36 order?
Are there specific certifications we can highlight (e.g., USDA Organic, Non-GMO, Vegan)?
